common:generalComment.#text: Insulating oil is an insulating medium formulated by adding antioxidants to deeply refined lubricating oil base oil. It is mainly used for insulation in electrical equipment such as transformers and oil switches. Its core properties include low-temperature fluidity (low pour point and low viscosity), oxidation stability (improved by antioxidants), and dielectric loss (the tangent value of the dielectric loss Angle is less than 0.5% at 90℃). It is classified into four major categories according to its application: transformer oil, oil switch oil, capacitor oil and cable oil. Naphthenic base oil is an ideal material for manufacturing this type of oil due to its excellent electrical properties. Modern products cover mineral type, natural ester type, synthetic ester type and silicone oil type. Among them, natural ester insulating oil is formulated with vegetable oil, featuring 100% biodegradability and a flash point twice as high as that of traditional oil products. Mixed insulating oil, by proportioning mineral oil and vegetable oil, can enhance the breakdown voltage and heat dissipation performance without modifying the equipment structure. All types of products must comply with the national standard GB 2536 and the international standard IEC 60296, and the application scenarios cover insulation and cooling of power transformers, industrial electrical equipment and new energy battery modules.

绝缘油是以深度精制的润滑油基础油加入抗氧剂调制而成的绝缘介质，主要用于变压器、油开关等电气设备的绝缘。其核心性能包括低温流动性（倾点低、粘度小）、氧化安定性（通过抗氧剂改善）和介质损耗（90℃时介质损耗角正切值低于0.5%），按用途分为变压器油、油开关油、电容器油和电缆油四大类。环烷基油因电气性能优异，是制造该油品的理想材料。现代产品涵盖矿物型、天然酯型、合成酯型及硅油型，其中天然酯绝缘油采用植物油配方，具备100%生物降解性和高于传统油品两倍的闪点。混合绝缘油通过矿物油与植物油配比，可在不改造设备结构的前提下提升击穿电压与散热性能。所有类型产品均需符合GB 2536国家标准及IEC 60296国际标准，应用场景覆盖电力变压器、工业电气设备及新能源电池模组的绝缘冷却。

common:generalComment.#text: Gas is one of the four fundamental states of matter, along with solids, liquids, and plasma. It consists of particles that have neither a defined volume nor defined shape. A pure gas may be made up of individual atoms, elemental molecules made from one type of atom, or compound molecules made from a variety of atoms. The term gas is also used in reference to the state itself when applied to matter that has the properties of a gaseous substance.

This dataset describes the product flow of 35-330kV high-voltage alternating current (AC) electricity from the point of generation, through transmission, to the final supply to the consumer who uses the electricity. The dataset is designed for customer-side use of electricity and reflects a mix of multiple sources of electricity, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear energy, and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure the accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessments of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: 核燃料棒是用于核反应堆中的关键组件，通常由铀氧化物（如UO₂）或其他核燃料材料制成。它们是将核燃料密封在金属管（通常是锆合金或不锈钢制成）的内部，形成长条形的结构。这些燃料棒在核反应堆中排列成束（燃料组件），用于在核裂变过程中释放能量。在反应堆中，核燃料棒通过核裂变反应释放热量，这些热量用于产生蒸汽并驱动发电机。燃料棒的设计确保它们能够在高温、高压和辐射环境下长时间稳定工作，同时控制反应堆中的核反应速率。

Nuclear fuel rods are key components used in nuclear reactors and are usually made of uranium oxides (e.g. UO₂) or other nuclear fuel materials. They are nuclear fuel sealed inside a metal tube (usually made of zirconium alloy or stainless steel) to form a long bar. These fuel rods are arranged in bundles (fuel assemblies) in a nuclear reactor and are used to release energy during the nuclear fission process. In the reactor, the nuclear fuel rods release heat through the nuclear fission reaction, and this heat is used to generate steam and drive a generator. The design of the fuel rods ensures that they can operate stably for long periods of time under high temperatures, pressures and radiation while controlling the rate of nuclear reactions in the reactor.
